room_rent.note: Product Benefit Table states 'Actuals up to Sum Insured (Any Room)'. Optional add-on (Room Rent Type Option C.14.3) can downgrade to Single Private A/C Room or Shared Accommodation if chosen.

icu.display: No cap – actuals up to SI
icu.note: Product Benefit Table: ICU Charges covered at actuals up to Sum Insured.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on inpatient claims. A 10% additional co-pay applies if hospitalisation exceeds 7 days without timely intimation (E.3.C). A 20% co-pay applies on OPD reimbursement claims when cashless is unavailable (optional OPD cover C.14.8). 20% additional co-pay for organ transplant non-compliance (E.3.D).

sub_limits.note: Durable Equipment Cover (optional) capped at ₹5L; Compassionate Visit (optional) capped at ₹50,000; Maternity (optional) capped at ₹1L/₹1.5L/₹2L; Newborn (optional) capped at ₹50k/₹1L/₹2L; Income Protect (optional) ₹50k/₹1L lump sum. Base inpatient benefits have no sub-limits beyond SI.

deductible.note: No deductible in base policy. HealthReturns can be used to pay a deductible if one is opted, but no deductible is mandated.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidental hospitalisation exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Standard PED waiting period is 24 months. Optional cover C.14.2 can reduce to 12 months (1 year) for an additional premium paid for 2 consecutive years.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Standard specific disease/procedure waiting period is 24 months. Optional cover C.14.1 can reduce to 12 months (1 year) for an additional premium paid for 2 consecutive years.

maternity.note: Worldwide Yuva Maternity Cover (C.14.9) is an optional cover. Waiting period options: 3 years, 2 years, or 1 year. Covers normal/C-section delivery (1 event), pre/post-natal 180 days each, ARS (IVF/IUI/ICSI/GIFT/ZIFT), egg freezing up to 30% of maternity SI, adoption up to ₹50k. Maternity SI options: ₹1L/₹1.5L/₹2L. Claims do not impact base SI.

cumulative_bonus.note: Yuva Credit: 100% of Base SI added per continuous renewal, up to maximum 1000% (10X) accumulation. Accrues regardless of claims. Not applicable if Unlimited SI opted.

restoration.note: Yuva Reload: First claim in policy life gets 2X Base SI. All subsequent claims get unlimited refill up to 100% of Base SI each time, for related and unrelated illnesses. Not applicable if Unlimited SI opted.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered at actuals up to SI; no minimum time limit applies for day-care.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered at actuals up to SI; minimum 3 consecutive days required.

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered at actuals up to SI; minimum 24-hour admission required at registered AYUSH hospital/day-care centre.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor hospitalisation expenses for harvesting covered at actuals up to SI. Pre/post-hospitalisation and logistics for donor not covered.

ambulance.note: Road and air ambulance (domestic only) covered at actuals up to Sum Insured. Air ambulance for emergency evacuation within India only.

modern_treatments.note: Listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stem cell therapy for haematological conditions, HIFU, balloon sinuplasty, deep brain stimulation, intra-vitreal injections, oral chemotherapy, stereotactic radio surgeries, bronchial thermoplasty, IONM, etc.) covered at actuals up to SI.

consumables.note: Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver, C.5) covers all four lists of non-medical/consumable expenses (Annexure I) as an inbuilt benefit. This waives the standard non-medical expense exclusion.

global_cover.note: Worldwide Yuva Maternity Cover (C.14.9) provides global coverage for maternity expenses. General hospitalisation is geographically restricted to India (D.2.8). No optional global inpatient cover available.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 30 days for all premium payment modes except monthly, where it is 15 days.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document for new individual policies. Not applicable on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers allowed as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: RFQMR, ECP/EECP, hyperbaric oxygen, KTP/femto laser, bioabsorbable implants, Infliximab/Rituximab/Avastin/Lucentis, RF ablation probe, off-label drug use, hormone replacement therapy, growth hormone therapy, external congenital anomaly

optional_riders.display: PED waiting reduction (24→12mo), Specific disease waiting reduction (24→12mo), Room rent type option, Yuva Health Check-up, Lifestyle Management Program, Durable Equipment Cover (up to ₹5L), Compassionate Visit, OPD Cover (up to 5X base premium), Worldwide Yuva Maternity Cover, Newborn Baby Cover, Income Protect Cover, FitForward Premium (Basic/Elite/Ultra)
